reviews.title: Has potential, but buggy
reviews.text:
This app has potential, but it is buggy and inaccurate. Even basic things such as showing my sign right are not working (shows my sun sign as Aquarius, but picture is Pisces, elementis water, polarity feminine...). I don’t even know much about Zodiac signs, but I know that Aquarius is supposed to be air. There is not much point for keeping this app, since it is inaccurate (in something that is already unscientific). Ad caught my eye, I like the graphics, thought it would be fun to have a look here and there, but if this is all completely random, there is no point. The UI is lovely though, hope you will work to improve corectness.

Update after 5 years: I downloaded this app again and it is prime example of dark UX patterns. The designers should be ashamed of themselves. I am changing my review to 1 star instead of two.

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with this app. I was charged 49 € without ever knowingly agreeing to or activating a subscription. At no point was it clearly stated that I was entering a paid subscription, and I did not authorize this charge.

This feels misleading and unethical. The payment process is not transparent, and the app design seems to push users into charges without clear consent. I contacted support, but this experience has already broken my trust.

I strongly warn other users to be very careful. Check your payments immediately after downloading or using this app. What happened to me feels like a scam, not a mistake.

I do NOT recommend this app.
